comments.author: @johnchapman1474
comments.text: I think the video is needlessly confusing for pro se inventors.  It leaves the impression that they should become registered eFilers before using EFS-Web.  It mentions only in passing that this is not the case - that inventors can use EFS-Web as an unregister eFiler to file their applications online.  I think it would be beneficial to spend more time on using EFS-Web to file an application before discussing Private PAIR.  It would be helpful for pro se inventors to demonstrate how to file an application on EFS-Web as an unregistered eFiler without confusing them on the process of becoming a registered eFiler and using Private PAIR.  More time should be spent on preparing the required patent documents in PDF format and uploading them using the appropriate document descriptions.  The video could then mention the benefits of becoming a registered eFiler so that they can access their applications online through Private PAIR and add follow-on documents.  Of course, this will soon be moot in view of the forthcoming Patent Center.
